page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top centre with page number at top right; catchword "cum" at the right below the last line. Small marks in the right margin are not printed text.

main_text.l: Mucium manus. num vel ipse patriam, vel
ipsum animus defecit? in quo solo ex decretis
Stoicorum virtus habitat ac viuit, Quemad-
modum iratus aliquis, vestem, quæ non satis
conuenit, in ignem jacit: ita manum, quæ er-
raurat, flammæ Mucius imposuit. Et ardebat
manus quidem: quid ni enim, caro, sanguis,
venæ, ossa? Animus autem non à corpore di-
visus modo, sed in eum jam euectus habitum,
supra quem ascendi non potest, cladéac rui-
nam corporis securus ac interritus spectabat.
Rixari cum natura rerum ac contendere di-
xisses; quod non absq; corpore se genuisset,
cujus eam partem, quæ virtutis munia ac
motus animi exequitur, spectante Rege atq;
attonito, tanquam ream, tanquam sui defer-
tricem, flammæ vstulandam rradidit. vt cum
armis ac viribus non posset, calamitasua re-
gem in stuporem daret. Obstrepant, obgan-
nant, oblatrent, qui in voluptate omnia re-
ponunt: nec dolorem suum æstimat vir fortis,
nec perferre alienum animus imbellis potest.
Itaque pro Mucio tum Porsena obstupuit,
qui virtutem tantam sine horrore non aspexit.
quod & mox patuit, cum inuictum sibi illum
populum videri serio testatus est. Quisquam
enim dubitat, quin si virtus ipsa, sine scutis,
hastis, gladiis ac machinis, sine ipso denique
videri posset corpore, totas in fugam acies
conuerteret: cujus tum imago atque effigies,
cum

page.notes: Marks in the right margin (small dashes and specks) are stains, not text. Some words are unclear at the scan's edge, notably "calamitasua" where an ink blot overlaps the word, and "rradidit", "erraurat" may be misprints as printed. Lines marked with ? are not included as no certain reading was possible at these points.
